title: Aether-Vault action log (GET /api/action-logs/{id}, v1.3.1)
description: python/av_server/server.py::_action_log_to_dict(). The registry-published INDEX ROW pointing at an append-only agent-decision log; the log itself ({"kind": "action_log", "actions": [{ts, actor, action, details, command}, ...]}, see python/av_cli/actionlog.py) is the referenced CAS object. `av replay-actions` fetches and optionally re-executes it. See docs/contracts.md.
